title: HVAC Member Uplift on Guest Unit Heating and Cooling Work, Optional Coverage Add-Ons
content:
An HVAC member uplift is added to the authorized item limit for Optional Coverage Add-Ons work when the component is a guest unit heating system or a guest unit cooling system. The uplift depends on the level of the customer's active agreement under the HVAC Maintenance Agreements:

| Component | Customer's active HVAC maintenance agreement | Uplift added to the item limit |
|---|---|---|
| Guest unit heating or cooling system | Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus, Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System Plus or Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier | USD 400.00 |
| Guest unit heating or cooling system | An active agreement at another level | USD 200.00 |
| Guest unit heating or cooling system | No active agreement | None |
| Any other component | Any | None |

Only an agreement in active status counts; the level is the one recorded on that agreement.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- A guest unit cooling system, with an active Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential agreement: USD 200.00 is added.
- A guest unit heating system, with an active Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier agreement: USD 400.00 is added.
- A guest unit kitchen appliance, with an active Comfort Care Plus agreement: nothing is added, since the component is neither heating nor cooling.
